scope: Eight groups of finite checks. Infinite-dimensional, asymptotic, Lean and novelty claims are not certified.

invariant_face.scope: Finite support and parameter algebra; no computation of a nonzero infinite-dimensional measure of noncompactness.

sign_lifts.scope: Explicit Hilbert lifts on complete finite sign cubes; not arbitrary Banach quotient optimization.

compact_shift.scope: Finite truncations of shift and moment identities; not an infinite-dimensional compactness or AP proof.

odd_edge_sums.scope: Exact finite-state moment recursions and reversible marked-box transitions; not the source linear-displacement construction.

chart_transport.scope: Explicit two-point translated charts, maximal matching and reverse couplings; not general finite Ramsey bounds.

cut_reconstruction.scope: Exact finite integer cuts and floating contractivity; no enumeration of infinite original coordinate support.

quartic_potential.scope: Exact polynomial inequalities and finite martingale telescoping; flatness control is deliberately tested.

stopped_medians.scope: Finite resolvents, triple-median enumeration, jump accounting and two-cost bounds; no general theorem or extension algorithm certification.
